---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
What are you trying to do that the runtime doesn't support today?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. If it touches the script API or CLI, sketch the shape.

**Dependency note**
The core is intentionally standard-library only. If your idea needs a
third-party package, explain why it belongs as an optional extra rather than a
core requirement.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything you've already tried or ruled out.
